{{< include _report_data.qmd >}}

This report estimates how vocabulary develops in children with Down syndrome and how that compares with typically developing children. The table below states the headline for each question; the quantities are defined in the primer (@sec-betabinomial, @sec-ratios, @sec-association), and every figure is read live from the model of record named in the row.

```{python}
# | label: tbl-at-a-glance
# | echo: false
# | output: asis

# Headline figures pulled live from the models of record (an em dash shows where a
# model has not yet been fitted into docs/report/figures/, so nothing is stale).
u36 = words("VG10", "posterior_summary_u", 36)
s36 = words("VG10", "posterior_summary_s", 36)
gap = num(val("VG10", "comprehension_production_gap", 37, "gap_median"))
r_peak = pct("VG15", "posterior_summary_r", 36, "r_median")
p_any36 = words("VG15", "posterior_summary_p_any", 36, "Ey_any_median")
dexp = num(comp_at("ds_td_expressive_delay", "words", 25, "dexp_median"))

_psi = psi_evidence()
if _psi:
    _row = load_summary("VG15", "posterior_summary_psi").iloc[0]
    psi_txt = (
        f"$\\psi \\approx$ {_row['psi_median']:.1f} "
        f"({_row['psi_hdi_lo']:.1f}–{_row['psi_hdi_hi']:.1f}; "
        f"{_psi[2]} evidence for an association; posterior odds {_psi[1]})"
    )
else:
    psi_txt = "the sign–speech association $\\psi$ (—)"

rows = [
    (
        "Words understood, spoken, and the gap (Down syndrome)",
        f"A typical child understands about {u36} and says about {s36} words at 36 months "
        f"(of an 800-word inventory); understanding runs ahead of speaking, and the "
        f"comprehension–production gap peaks near {gap} words around 37 months.",
        "VG10",
        "@sec-findings-ds",
    ),
    (
        "Signing, the sign–speech association, and total expressive vocabulary (Down syndrome)",
        f"The sign ratio peaks at about {r_peak} of understood words near 36 months; within "
        f"understood words, signing and speaking co-occur more than chance — {psi_txt}; total "
        f"expressive vocabulary is about {p_any36} words at 36 months.",
        "VG15",
        "@sec-findings-signing",
    ),
    (
        "Words spoken versus typically developing children",
        "A developmental *stretch*, not a constant lag: by 24 months almost all children with "
        "Down syndrome produce fewer spoken words than the typically developing 10th centile, "
        "and peak word-learning arrives roughly four years later.",
        "VG11",
        "@sec-comparison-td",
    ),
    (
        "Understood words and the gap, young window (versus typically developing)",
        f"A production-specific deficit: even at matched comprehension, children with Down "
        f"syndrome take about {dexp} more months to say words they already understand "
        f"(at 25 understood words).",
        "VG13",
        "@sec-comparison-td",
    ),
]

print("| Question | Headline finding | Model of record | Full findings |")
print("|---|---|---|---|")
for q, finding, model, where in rows:
    print(f"| {q} | {finding} | {model} | {where} |")
print(
    "\n: Findings at a glance. Each headline is generated from the named model of "
    "record; follow the link for the full estimates and their uncertainty. {#tbl-at-a-glance}"
)
```

Every figure above is a posterior median for the _typical_ child, reported with a 94% credible interval and the spread expected across _individual_ children in the chapters that follow; @sec-supersedes explains how a model earns "of record" status, and the per-model convergence gate (@sec-appendix-b1) shows the diagnostics were cleared before any estimate was read. For how to read a credible interval and a posterior-predictive range, see the primer; for the cross-model synthesis, see @sec-synthesis <!-- synthesis.qmd -->.
